Board of Supervisors Meeting Schedule

Clerk of the Board's deadline for submission is 5 p.m. on the indicated date.

Starting May 2026, Regular meetings will begin at 5 p.m. All meetings are held at the following location:
Board of Supervisors Hearing Room
Pima County Administration Building
130 West Congress, 1st Floor
Tucson, AZ.

Ways to join live meetings

  • In person at address above.
  • Available on cable: Cox Channel 96.
  • Watch the Board of Supervisors’ Meeting Live (Granicus)
  • Watch the Board of Supervisors' Meeting Live (YouTube)

    Public comments can be submitted to [email protected].  All public comments submitted for agenda items will be made public and added to the online agenda.

  * Start time for Study Sessions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

   **A Study Session may be added to the second meeting of every month to accommodate Executive Session     items only. The start time will be 3:00 p.m.
